connection.title: Connection mode
connection.description: Choose how Home Assistant talks to the gate. Cloud only keeps the original MyNice relay behavior. Local first uses a LAN IT4WIFI address first and falls back to cloud.

data_description.local_host: Manual IP address or hostname of the IT4WIFI module. Leave empty for cloud only.
data_description.local_port: Local TLS port. IT4WIFI usually uses 443.

account.title: MyNice account
account.description: Update your MyNice credentials or re-select the gate. Leave password empty to keep the current password.

actions.title: Nice actions
actions.description: Choose an action. [HA button] means a Home Assistant button entity is enabled. [Yandex switch] means a switch entity for Yandex exposure is enabled.

action.title: Action settings
action.description: Additional entity settings for `{action_key}`. Service: `nice_gate.{service_name}`. Open, close and stop are always available through the main gate cover; the checkboxes below create extra entities.

data_description.action_title: This name is used for generated entities.
data_description.show_dashboard: When enabled, a separate button entity appears under the device. You can add it to a dashboard manually.
data_description.expose_yandex: When enabled, a separate switch entity appears and can be exposed to Yandex.
